degree.text: Degree Awarded Master of Business Administration

description.text: Why study in BUAA 1．China’s first university of aeronautics and astronautics engineering and academic research. 2．one of the most famous universities in China, equipped with advancedlaboratories and teaching apparatus. 3．Campus is known for its beautiful environment, convenient transportation and various facilities.. 4．Situated in the capital in the center of Zhongguancun Science Park, next to China’s National Olympic Center. 5．Located in the west of Beijing, close to the thriving boutiques and cafes of Wudaokou. 6．Equipped with high quality teaching team and professional laboratories. Program Introduction The MBA is designed to cultivate business management executives of the future for senior leadership positions in China and globally. Studying an MBA in China equips students with strategic foresight and entrepreneurial spirit as well as decision-making and problem-solving capabilities. Teaching Objective To help student obtain knowledge and ability of business management, economic management and enterprise management, and enable student to deal with all kinds of business management related work in all kinds of organizations. Main Courses For reference: Principles of Management, micro-economics, Management Information System, Statistics, Marketing, Economic Law, Human Resource Management, Enterprise Strategic Management, Finance Management Fee Structure Tuition fee: 35000RMB/year Internship Human resources, planning, purchasing or sales management in the enterprise. Duration 3 years Degree Awarded Master of Business Administration Future Career Banking, consultancy, accountancy, marketing, advertising, human resource management and general management. Teaching Facilities The school has 7 national level key laboratories, 3 national level engineering research centers, 42 provincial and ministerial level key laboratories. Also has 4 Innovative Research Groups of National Natural Science Foundation of China, 11 Innovation Teams of Ministry of Education, 6 Defense-Related Science and Technology Innovation Teams. Teacher Highlight 3759 faculties and staffs are on the job, including 2102 full-time teachers, 1668 professors and associate professors, 73.0% of teachers have doctorate degree. There are 17 academicians of Chinese Academy of Sciences and Chinese Academy of Engineering, 16 hired experts of “Thousands of People Plan” from the Organization Department of the of the CPC Central Committee, 23 chief scientists of “973” plan, 41 professors of “Changjiang Scholars Program”, 31 obtainers of “National Science Fund for Distinguished Young Scholars”, high-level talented persons represented by three national level teaching masters, etc..

duration.text: The Business Administration at Beihang University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 7. Financial support statement A certificate from the financial guarantor of the applicant.

requirements.text: 1.The Applicant should be expected to study hard, observe the laws and decrees of the Chinese government and abide by the regulations of BUAA. 2.In general the applicant should have a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) degree or have the equivalent educational background of (a B.S.) degree. 3.The applicant should be forty years of age or under. 4.The applicant must have a good command of English and have the ability to take courses in English or Chinese.
